newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down two cents despite higher LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down two cents despite higher LME.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down two cents at 14.55 ringgit ($5.76) a kg, extending Thursday's 15-cent drop, as the market continued to adjust to recent falls on the London Metal Exchange, traders said.
The domestic price had held relatively steady despite the recent sharp drop in London and "it needs to correct", said a local trader.
LME tin closed $40 higher on Thursday.
Traders have pegged immediate support for the local price at 14.50 ringgit.
They noted initial bids for 74 tonnes against offers for 85 tonnes. Final turnover was 75 tonnes, down from 98 on Thursday, and buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia, they said.
The local price premium over the LME narrowed to $95 a tonne against $145 previously, the traders said.
